Write a VTK file

Source: R/mesh-io.R
write_vtk.Rd

Writes a mesh, finite-element function or solution in the legacy ASCII VTK unstructured-grid format, readable by ParaView and VisIt. P1 data are written on linear triangles; P2 data on quadratic triangles (VTK cell type 22) with all six nodal values, which ParaView renders with curved interpolation. A displacement solution of elasticity_problem() is written as a VECTORS array, optionally with the nodal stresses of elasticity_stress() (on the vertices, as P1 data). A time-dependent solution is written at one stored time (all species for reaction-diffusion systems); call it once per time to write a series.

Usage

write_vtk(x, file, name = "u", time = NULL, stress = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A pde_mesh(), fe_function(), pde_solution, pde_vector_solution or pde_transient.

file

Output path.

name

Name of the point data array (scalar data and displacements).

time

Stored time to write for a pde_transient (default: the last).

stress

For elasticity solutions, also write sxx, syy, sxy and von_mises (P1 solutions only, since the stresses are vertex values).

Value

The file path, invisibly.

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".vtk")
write_vtk(pde_mesh_rectangle(nx = 2), f)
